meta.description: Universal multimodal memory schema for selfcreate agent

indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_user_id ON personal_memory(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_memory_key ON personal_memory(memory_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_expires_at ON personal_memory(expires_at);

bootstrap_sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_profile (user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), full_name TEXT, preferred_name TEXT, date_of_birth DATE, gender TEXT, email TEXT, phone TEXT, language_preference TEXT, timezone TEXT, country TEXT, city TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS personal_memory (memory_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID REFERENCES user_profile(user_id), category TEXT NOT NULL, memory_key TEXT NOT NULL, memory_value TEXT NOT NULL, source_text TEXT, confidence DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0.0, importance_score DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0.0, memory_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (memory_type IN ('TEMPORARY','SHORT_TERM','LONG_TERM')), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, tags JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interaction_log (interaction_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID REFERENCES user_profile(user_id), user_message TEXT NOT NULL, assistant_response TEXT NOT NULL, decision_should_store BOOLEAN NOT NULL, decision_reason TEXT, latency_ms INT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS face_memory (face_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id UUID REFERENCES user_profile(user_id), person_name TEXT NOT NULL, confidence DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0.0, last_snapshot_path TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media_input_log (media_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, interaction_id BIGINT REFERENCES interaction_log(interaction_id), input_mode TEXT NOT NULL, audio_text TEXT, video_snapshot_path TEXT, video_change_score DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT 0.0, video_significant_change BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, faces_detected_count INT DEFAULT 0, faces_payload JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW());
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_user_id ON personal_memory(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_memory_key ON personal_memory(memory_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_personal_memory_expires_at ON personal_memory(expires_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_face_memory_person_name ON face_memory(person_name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_media_input_log_created_at ON media_input_log(created_at);
